title: The PC industry just showed its first signs of growth in 6 years - but don't expect this rebound to last (HPQ, AAPL)
text: The PC industry just showed its first signs of growth in 6 years — but don't expect this rebound to last (HPQ, AAPL) By Troy Wolverton Jul 12, 2018, 6:24 pm 20 pts Worldwide PC shipments grew in the second quarter for the first time in six years, Gartner reported Thursday. But that rebound isn't likely to last, Gartner warned. Consumers continue to abandon PCs for smartphones, schools are turning to Chromebooks, and business demand was boosted by an upgrade…
